note: Literature directly demonstrates that KDM6B variants downregulate FOLR1 expression and correlate with FOLR1 autoantibodies in cerebral folate deficiency cohorts.

evidence.text: Exome sequencing in 48 CFD cases identified six KDM6B variants in five patients (10%). Functional experiments demonstrated that KDM6B variants decreased KDM6B protein expression, elevated H3K27me2, reduced H3K27Ac, decreased FOLR1 protein levels, and were associated with serum FOLR1 autoantibodies.

source.title: KDM6B Variants May Contribute to the Pathophysiology of Human Cerebral Folate Deficiency
source.quote: Six KDM6B variants were identified in five CFD patients, which accounts for 10% of our CFD cohort cases. Functional experiments indicated that these KDM6B variants decreased the amount of KDM6B protein, which resulted in elevated H3K27me2, lower H3K27Ac and decreased FOLR1 protein concentrations.
